[size=3][color=#999999]This mod aims to add romantic depth to married female NPCs, featuring elaborate romantic storylines and adult-themed interaction events.[/color]
[color=#999999]At present, the mod delivers immersive plots and full quest lines for[/color] [b][color=#b6b6b6]Robin, Caroline and Jodi, alongside a custom map. The three characters come with roughly 40 unique events in total. [/color][/b][/size][/font]

[left][font=Times New Roman][color=#6aa84f][size=4]Details & Future Plans[/size][/color]
[color=#999999][size=3]To be honest, I originally made this mod just for my own fun.
I plan to add more characters in the future, all of which will be integrated into this single mod.
I have no plans to release any separate standalone mods.
The mod is compatible with other mods as of now.
However, I cannot guarantee compatibility in future updates, as compatibility testing is extremely time-consuming and difficult.[/size][/color][/font]
